description: Grant as much as fits, updating state only by the granted amount.

methods.name: Partial
methods.header:
method Partial(used: int, req: int, cap: int) returns (next: int, grant: int)
  requires 0 <= used <= cap && req >= 0
  ensures grant == (if req <= cap - used then req else cap - used)
  ensures next == used + grant
  ensures 0 <= next <= cap

reference.Partial:
if req + used <= cap { grant := req; } else { grant := cap - used; }
  next := used + grant;

mutants.violation: Uses full requested amount instead of the partial amount when capacity is tight.

provenance: Locally authored quota-domain diagnostic. Not a public/industrial PSM, independent external source, or held-out benchmark.
